research_question: Under a verifier-first prospective task corpus, which executor/policy treatment minimizes complete system resource cost per verified solved task while preserving task success and reproducibility?
secondary_questions: Does deterministic task shaping reduce complete system cost?
Can economic/local/free executors plus verification/escalation match strong direct at lower complete system cost?
Does deterministic state-based escalation outperform cheap direct execution?
Does static family policy perform closely enough to dynamic escalation to avoid a smarter custom policy?
Can existing frameworks/standards provide the required infrastructure without a new DV runtime/router?

hypotheses.H0-A: B2 has no reproducible system-cost advantage over simpler baselines
hypotheses.H1-A: B2 lowers complete system cost per verified solved task versus B0/B1 while preserving acceptable solve rate
hypotheses.H0-B: S1 provides no reproducible complete-system improvement over S0
hypotheses.H1-B: S1 reduces complete system resources or increases verified solve rate enough to offset its own cost
hypotheses.H0-C: B3 is not materially worse than more dynamic policy
hypotheses.H0-D: B4 provides no useful cost/performance frontier
hypotheses.H1-D: B4 achieves useful verified success at a lower monetary/system-resource frontier

executor_requirements: programmatic identity capture timeout telemetry/cost contract

input_requirements: one strong and one economic/local/free path
task_requirements: 2-4 tasks across 2 families preferred; one task smoke exception
multiple task instances per included family
same admitted task set across treatments
executor_requirements: same pinned cohort or explicit drift cohort

minimums.S1: 2-4 admitted tasks across at least 2 operationalizable families preferred; one task is smoke-only
minimums.S2: at least 3 admitted tasks per included family preferred; fewer means task-limited claims
minimums.S3: repetitions selected after S2 variance and resource review using one policy for all treatments
minimums.S4: new verifier-first sealed external holdout; no legacy P0 holdout reuse by default
